EmailTemplate.description: Info needed to cancel ASU application
EmailTemplate.name: Decline Request - Non-student request
EmailTemplate.subject: Information needed to cancel application
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for contacting Admission Services at Arizona State University. Only the student who applied can request to cancel the application. Your student may submit a request by logging in to https://students.asu.edu/canceladmissions with his or her ASURITE UserID and password. Students who have forgotten their ASURITE ID or password may call the Help Desk at 480-965-6500 to reset their password.
A student who is unable to access the form may email a request to decline@asu.edu using the email of record with ASU (the one entered on the application) or offical asu.edu email address, including either their ASU ID number or date of birth (mm/dd/yy). This information verifies that we are canceling the correct student’s application.
Your student can contact his or her personal admission representative at https://asu.edu/findmyrep with any questions.
Sincerely,
Admission Services asu.edu
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
